terms.comment: A description of ours: the lexicon’s thōrāx for a jumper (see “sweater”), with cucullātus, hooded, a late word (Isidore’s vestis cucullāta) that Morgan–Owens uses of a hooded coat. We have found no word for a hoodie in Traupman, Morgan–Owens, or Levi–Bini.

phrases.latin: Thōrācem cucullātum indue et cucullum in caput trahe.
phrases.english: Put your hoodie on and pull the hood over your head.

sources: Lewis & Short: thorax · Lewis & Short: cucullatus · Lewis & Short: cucullus
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. jacket, coat: coat with a hood.
